thread:
alex: Heads up — last night's aggregation spike recurred for dataset "ingest_spans_rollup" around 02:13 UTC. Root cause not the same as before but symptoms match (missing spans + count drift). I've sketched a short ops playbook below. Need owner & ETA for remediations. cc @maria @sanjeev

maria: Ack. Can you paste the sample query and affected time window?

alex: Window: 2026-03-20T02:10:00Z -> 02:25:00Z. Query we used to validate counts:
```
SELECT service, count(*) FROM spans_raw
WHERE ingested_at BETWEEN '2026-03-20'::timestamptz + '02:10' AND '02:25'
GROUP BY service;
```
We saw service X down ~82% compared to expected.

sanjeev: Thanks. Early hypothesis: ETL worker pool throttled due to Kinesis checkpoint lag + recent batch size change. I'll triage logs for 02:10-02:20. Assigning to me for triage, will report in 40m. :mag:

katie: Adding quick checklist to playbook:
- Confirm missing spans vs dropped ingestion
- Check worker restart timeline
- Verify aggregator window alignment (timezone/rounding)
- Run backfill test for service X on dev

alex: Proposed remediations:
1) Revert batch-size change in etl-proc config (owner: infra-team, ETA: 6h)
2) Add guard on Kinesis lag in runner (owner: sanjeev, ETA: 24h)
3) Short-term backfill for missing window (owner: maria, ETA: 48h)
4) Add recurring weekly check (owner: katie, ETA: 72h)
5) Postmortem action item: add metric: aggregator_window_mismatch_count (owner: alex, ETA: 1w)

maria: I can take #3. I'll run backfill on staging today and then submit a runbook for prod backfill. ETA check: aiming to start in 3h, finish in 24–36h depending on throughput.

sanjeev: For #2 — I'll add a soft throttle trigger: if kinesis_lag > 5m then reduce inflight batches and emit alert. Patch + unit tests -> PR today. If anyone can review quickly? @alex @katie

alex: I'll review PR. katie can you own #4 and the weekly check alert config?

katie: Yep. Will add a Prometheus alert and PagerDuty rule. Proposed name: "observability.aggregate_window_mismatch_weekly_check". I'll post config snippet when done.

ops-bot: Incident task created: INC-2026-3145 assigned to maria,sanjeev,katie,alex. Remediation checklist link: https://redwood.internal/incident/INC-2026-3145

maria: One more note — this looks like a recurring long-tail pattern that surfaces when traffic spikes + small config changes. Suggest we add a "canary" run after any ETL config change (10% traffic) to catch regressions.

alex: Agreed. Let's make "canary after ETL config change" a mandatory step in deployment checklist for etl-proc. I'll update the runbook and notify release engineering.

sanjeev: Quick debug snippet: found repeated error in worker logs:
```
2026-03-20T02:12:27Z ERROR checkpoint: failed to commit seq=834927, err=timeout
```
Piling commits caused backlog.

katie: Ok, owners and ETAs look good. Can we sync 1hr from now for status? If any blockers, escalate to oncall SRE.

alex: 1hr sync scheduled. I'll start a quick doc with owners + links. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
